strands.name: Strand A: Mathematical Thinking and Making Connections

overalls.title: Mathematical Processes
overalls.description: apply the mathematical processes to develop a conceptual understanding of, and procedural fluency with, the mathematics they are learning

specifics.description: I can apply problem-solving strategies and mathematical processes to develop fluency and deepen my understanding.
I can make connections between mathematics and real-life situations, various knowledge systems, and career applications.

overalls.title: Number Sets and Development
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the development and use of numbers, and make connections between sets of numbers

specifics.description: I can describe the development of number concepts across cultures and explain relationships between subsets of numbers.

overalls.title: Operations and Computation
overalls.description: represent numbers in various ways, evaluate expressions, and solve problems using rational numbers and exponent rules

specifics.description: I can apply exponent rules and order of operations to simplify expressions involving powers and rational numbers.
I can solve problems involving ratios, proportions, percentages, and financial concepts.

overalls.title: Algebraic Expressions and Equations
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of algebraic expressions and equations, and use them to model situations and solve problems

specifics.description: I can add, subtract, expand, and simplify algebraic expressions including polynomials.
I can solve first-degree equations and inequalities algebraically and graphically.

overalls.title: Coding and Mathematical Modelling
overalls.description: create, execute, and refine computer code to perform mathematical tasks and model relationships

specifics.description: I can write and refine code using variables, loops, and conditionals to solve mathematical problems.

overalls.title: Data Management and Analysis
overalls.description: collect, organize, represent, and analyze data to draw conclusions and solve problems

specifics.description: I can design data collection plans, analyze one-variable and two-variable data, and evaluate bias.

overalls.title: Geometric Relationships and Measurement
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of geometric relationships and solve problems involving perimeter, area, surface area, and volume

specifics.description: I can apply geometric theorems (such as angle relationships and Pythagorean theorem) to solve geometric problems.
I can calculate perimeter, area, surface area, and volume of 2D shapes and 3D figures.

overalls.title: Financial Decisions and Applications
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of financial concepts and apply them to make informed financial decisions

specifics.description: I can analyze financial scenarios involving earning income, budgeting, simple/compound interest, and appreciation/depreciation.
